content: Nabucodonosor-e-gabdaksad
Nabucodonosor birgabogus-negsemaigua, gabdakardaed. We-ibmar-dakedbali sulibinsa-itodii gualid. Degisoggu, a-ulale, bar-nue gabdisulid.

Rey-Nabucodonosor na e-gabdaksad ega odulogegala, ibmar-burbaled-oyoged-dulese, ibmar-burbaled-wisid-nerguarmalad-dulese, ina-isgana-imakmalad-dulemarse, degi, Caldeo-dule-binsaed-ibedmarse gochad. Degisoggu, we-dulemar bela Rey-Nabucodonosor-asabin gwisgunonimalad.
Rey, amarga weyob sogded: —An-gabdaksad bukib-binsae an-imaked. Degisoggu, an wisgubied, we-gabdakedde, ¿ibu anga obare?
Geb rey-asabin Caldeo-dulemar-ambikunonimaladi, Arameo-gwabindukuba sogdemalad: —¡Rey, degisadegu be dula-gudiguena gadin! Anmarga be-gabdaksad be soge, geb anmar bega nabir odulogoed.

Rey-Nabucodonosor, Caldeo-dulemar-abin-imakde weyob ega sogded: —An-gabdaksad an iesad. Ar be anga an-gabdaksad sogsurmalale, degi, odulosurmarbalile, bemar-olomakega, degine, be-negmar burubi-sii imakega, an igar ukoed.

Ar bemar anga an-gabdaksad sogerdina, degi, odulomarbardibe, adi, an bemarga ibmar-nuegan ukoed, degi, be-nugmar an odummobaloed. Degisoggu, be anga an-gabdaksad sogmala, deginbali, be anga odulomarbali.
Dule-nergumalad gannar reyga sogdemalad: —Rey, be anmarga be-gabdaksad soge, geb anmar bega odulogoed.
Rey-Nabucodonosor abin-imakde, ega sogded: —Bato an igar-mesisad. A-igar bemar nue-wisid, a-ulale, bemar yamo weyob gunanaid.

Bemar anga an-gabdaksad sogsurmardibe, unnila igar-soggwen bemarga maid, sabsur-odurdakleged-igar. Bemar anga gakansamalaga gunanaid, anga yogasaar ibmar-sogega gunanaid, agala bemar yoggunanaid. Degisoggu, anga an-gabdaksad sogmala, deyobi, an wisguoed, bemar sunna anga nabir we-gabdaked odulomalodibe.

Geb Caldeo-dule-nerguarmalad rey-abin sogdemalad: —We-napneggine, dule-wargwensaale we-igar-be-egisnaid-oduloged gudisulid. Deginbali, rey-wargwensaale, dule-dummad-negdakmaid-wargwensaale, degi, dummad-wargwensaale, ibmar-burbaled-oyoged-nergudimaladse, dule-ibmar-burbaled-wisid-nerguarmaladse, degi, Caldeo-dulemar-binsaed-ibedmarse, weyobi, ibmar egisdisurmalad.
Ar dummad-rey anmarse-ibmar-egisnaidi yeer-gangued, ar dule-wargwensaale geg ega soged, unni bab-dummagan-dulemar-abargi-gudisurmaladbi, we-ibmar oduloged.
Rey-Nabucodonosor, weyob ega sogsa-itosgua, sae-itoded, nue-uluded. Degisoggu, rey bela Babilonia-neggweburgi dule-binsaed-ibegan-gudidimalad-ogilogega igar uksad.
Deyobi, gardamar meslenonikid, dulemar-binsaed-ibegan-gudidimalad bela oburgwilemaloye. Degisoggu, oburgwilegega, Daniel e-aimarmala amilearmogad.
Degidbali, Daniel, sorda-Ariocʼga nuedgi, degi, ise-binsaed-nikaa ega sunmaksad. Ariocʼde, rey-sordamar-e-dummadid. We-dulede, dule-binsaed-ibegan-Babiloniaʼgi-gudimalad bato oburgwesokalinad.
Daniel, Ariocʼga sogded: “Rey, dule-binsaed-ibegan-oburgoye garda-mesisadi, ¿ibiga gwae-gwae-imakbie?” Degidgine, Arioc, Danielʼga bela ibmar-ogwasad, ibiga rey weyob igar-uksa.
Geb agine, Daniel, rey-daknadgusad. Geb Daniel, gabdaked-odulogegala, reyse ibagan ega napi-osuguye egichisad.
A-sorbali, Daniel e-negse naded, geb e-aimar Ananíasʼga, Misaelʼga, degi, Azaríasʼga neg-gunaid sogdapid.

Degidgine, Daniel na e-aimarga sogsad, ede-nabir-rey-gabdaksad-odulogega, ega Bab-Dummad-Nibneggi-Maid-dule-wile-dakedse gormaloye. Adi, Daniel, degi, e-aimarmala, mer Babilonia-dulemar-binsaed-ibeganmarba oburgwilemalagar.
Mutikidbali, Danielʼga rey-gabdaksad negburgan-dakedba oyolesad. A-ulale, Daniel Bab-Dummad-Nibneggi-Maidgi nued sunmakded.
Daniel weyob sogded:

content.text: Emigindi, anmar ibmar-bese-egichad be anga oyononikid,

content: Daniel, Nabucodonosor-e-gabdaksad odulosad

Degigusad-sorbali, Daniel, Arioc-daknaded. Rey, Arioc-onug-imaksagusad, Babilonia-dule-binsaed-ibegan-oburgwegar. Daniel, Ariocʼga sogded: —Mer be Babilonia-dule-binsaed-ibegan oburgwe. Rey-asabin be an-sede, an ega gabdaked odulogoed.
Degisoggu, Arioc rey-asabin gwae-gwae Daniel-sesad. Geb Arioc reyga weyob sogded: —Judá-dulemar-selenonikid-abargi dule-gwensak sunna bega gabdaked-oduloged an amisad.
Geb rey, Daniel-Beltsasarʼye-nugbalidse egichided, ega sogded: —¿An-gabdaksad, anga be sunna sogsale? ¿Anga be odulosbalile?

Daniel reyga weyob sogded: —Dule-binsaed-ibed-gudiid, dule-ibmar-wilubgan-burbaled-oyoged, dule-ibmar-burbaled-wisid, dule-niisgwamargi-nergualed, wemar-wargwensaale be-gabdaksad gege bega odulomalad.

Ar degi-inigwele, nibneggi Bab-Dummad gwensak-maid, abi ibmar-burbarmalad oduloged. Rey-Nabucodonosor, we-Bab-Dummad, ibagan-danikoedgi-ibmar-gumaloed, bega oyosad. Be gabmaigua, be weyob gabdaksad, degine, be weyob negburgan daksabalid.
”Rey, be obunnomaigua, yoedse-neggumaloedgi be binsamai gualid. Geb Bab-Dummad-Nibneggi-Maid ibmar-burbarmalad-oduloged, yoedse-negguoed bega oyosad.
Angala be-gabdaksad oyolesmogad. We-soglesulid, andi bur dule-bamaladba ibmar nue-wisye. Rey, be-gabdaksad anga-oyolesad, adi, an bega odulogega, degi, be ibmargi-binsamaigusad be magar itogegar.
”Rey, be gabdakmaigua, ibmar-duleyob-sobaled, be-asabin bipisur-gwichi be daksad. We-duleyob-sobaled yeer-dungued, degine, binnasur gabalid. E-daklegedi swirisur-dakleged.
”Rey, be we-ibmar-dakgwisgua, akwa-dummad dule-gwen-mecharsuli mellenonikid. We-akwa, ibmar-duleyob-sobaled e-nagmar-esgorogi, degi, napsagi-sobaledgi, yolenonikid, geb bela akwase goamaksad.

Geb degine, esgoro, napsa, esgoro-gordikid, mani, degi, or bela eba goamakdemarmogad. We-duleyob-ibmar-sobaled, ar igi oros-e-uka neg-yoladgine burwa-abinni mileddae, deyobi, burwa-abin miledmogad, bar gwen gwichi gussulid. Ar akwa-egi-yolenonikiddi yar-dummadga dungumai gusad. Bela napneg ganonikid.
”Dummad, weyob be gabdaksa gusad. Emisgindi, an bega soggwelo, we ibu obare:
Be, rey-gued. Rey-bamalad-abargi, be rey-dummadga gued. Bab-Dummad-Nibneggi-Maid, rey-gangi-sigega be-imaksad. Gangued-nikadba-negseed, gargangued, degi, nug-dummarba-gued bega uksabalid.

Bela dulemar-we-napneggi-bukwad, be-argan-yaurgine bega uksad. Deginbali, ibmar-durgan-sapurba-bukwad, sikwimarse-bakale, be-argan-yaurgine uksabalid. Bela wemar-birgi-dummadga-megega be imaksad. Ibmar-duleyob-sobaled-e-nono-orbiidi, we, be gued.
”Be-sorbali, rey-yar-baidgined beba bur dule-nug-nikasulid nonikoed. A-rey-sorbali, baid-rey-yar-baidgined esgoro-gordikid-e-wilubga-gued nonikoed, adi, bela we-napneggi neg-ganonikoed.
Napidgine, baid-rey-yar-baidgined esgoroyob-gangued-nikad nonikoed. Esgoro, igi bela ibmar-bibisge, degi, bela ubigwar-sii ibmar-imakbali, deyobi, baid-reymar-negsemamaid ese guoed.
”Dummad-rey, e-nagmar, degi, e-nag-goomar, esgorogi-sobaled, degi, napsagi-sobaled be daksadi, wedi mamarar-negselegoed oyoged. Degi-inigwele, esgoro-gangued-nikadyob gangued wis nikumogoed.
Ar e-nag-goomar-esgorogi, degi, napsagi-sobaledi, wedi sogleged, we-yar wis gannarba negselegoed, gines nollo negselebaloed.
Dummad, esgoro, napsabo-oburar be daksad, we-ibmarmar na ebogwa gege achaa nagued. Deyobi, we-yar-e-dulemar na apurmaloenad, degi-inigwele, bulakwaa ambikumalosulid.

”We-reymar-ibagangine, Bab-Dummad-Nibneggi-Maid, na rey-wargwen-degisadegu-reyga-megoed barmidagoed. We-reygi, dule-baid bipisaar obinosulid. Ar we-rey bur yar-bamalad-obelogoed. We-rey, degisadegu reyga megoed.
Dummad, be daksagusad, akwa-dummad dule-gwen-barmassuli yar-birgi argwannargusad. We-akwa ibmar-duleyob-sobaledgi yolenonigua,
”Bab-Bur-Dummad, yoedsega igi-neg-guoe, bega oyosad. We-gabdaklesad napiragwadid, degi, e-odulolesad innikigwadid, egi bengulesulid.”
Rey-Nabucodonosor, weyob itosgua, Daniel-asabin bebe napase dulluu imaksad. Geb Danielʼga ina-wawagwad-ogaega, degine, ibmar-nuegan-ukega igar-uksabalid.

Rey-Nabucodonosor, Danielʼga weyob sogded: —Napirado. Be-Bab-Dummadi, bamalad-bab-dummagan-e-Bab-Dummadid, reymar-mamaid-e-Dummadbalid. Be-Bab-Dummad, bela igarmar-burbar-mamaid oduloged. A-ulale, an-gabdaksad be nabir odulosad.

Geb degine, Rey-Nabucodonosor dummadga Daniel-nug-imaksad, geb ibmar-nuegan-bukidar ega uksabalid. Deginbali, rey, bela Babilonia-yar-naidgi-negseega, degi, dule-binsaed-nued-nikamalad-e-dummadga-guega Daniel-nug-imaksabalid.

Geb degine, Daniel reyse egichisad, e-aimar-Sadrac, Mesac, degi, Abednego, dummaganga onugsamoye. A-sogedbali, rey, we-masmala Babilonia-yargi ega ibmar-akwega onugsasad. Danielʼdi rey-walik arbadii gusad.
